body: Q133 done. Branch qwen/q133-clip-coverage pushed. Census: 158/534 motion techniques covered (29.6%%), up from 15. 121 new BINDINGS entries with provenance field (exact/near), 21 more via existing TECHNIQUE_CLIP_ALIASES. Rule: EXACT=vendor noun matches technique name, NEAR=same motion under another name, NONE=no clip. Census tool at tools/q133_clip_coverage.gd re-runs classification from live data. 10 bindings load-verified (5 EXACT + 5 NEAR) with track counts and durations. Parse gate clean, --only clip 10/10, --only playback 2/2. 376 NONE are mostly judo (85 across 7 disciplines), BJJ submissions (19), and savate/capoeira with no clips on disk.
